title: Stellarium Session Target Magnitude Leaderboard
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stellarium:session magnitude=*
| stats sum(magnitude) as total_value, avg(magnitude) as avg_value by target_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks target values by total and average target magnitude across Stellarium session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `magnitude` values for each Stellarium session event and review total and average target magnitude by target.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total target magnitude.
grandmaExplanation: It notes which target shows the biggest target magnitude numbers in your Stellarium session data.
